QUOTE: If both macros are defined, `platform.c:20-22` compiles out the whole runtime mechanism, so `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared or available.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that on the macro path the setter is neither declared nor compiled (the runtime mechanism is compiled out), which matches the item. The earlier line saying `platform.h` declares it only when the macros are undefined supports this.
